name: YZ Aur
description: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that pulsates every 18.19 days; its mean radius is 103.7 solar radii.

radius.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, YZ Aur: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 103.7 +/- 10.7 (Monte-Carlo)

temperature.source: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 286, Name='YZ Aur', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5125 +/- 243 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic)

distance.source: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, YZ Aur: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 4245.2 +/- 428.5 (Monte-Carlo)

color.reason: Interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.601 +/- 0.058 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation

text.card: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 18.2 days.
text.introduction: Its mean radius, 103.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 4,245 parsecs away.
text.locator: table10, YZ Aur: Per, Rad, Dist

notes: The star pulsates; it is drawn at its mean radius.
No dynamical mass is measured for this Cepheid; its mass is left unmeasured.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 188724234539584256 (quality A), from 2022ApJS..259...35A; Gaia DR3 measures none
